theme.mechanism: CSS light-dark() on :root; color-scheme is 'light dark' by default (Auto) and is forced by :root[data-theme='light'|'dark'].

narrative.overview:
fuet.ch is a blog where the page is the post. One calm reading column sits on a warm cream ground, framed by a slim masthead at the top and a dark coffee band at the bottom. On wide screens the frame uses the width: lists show each post's cover beside its row, and a post puts its cover beside the title and a contents list beside the text. Nothing competes with the text: no cards.

The mood is warm and quiet. Coffee-brown ink on cream, one electric orange used sparingly, and soft cream panels for quotes and code. The visitor is here to read, so every choice serves a long text on a phone or a laptop: an 18 px body, a line height of 1.6, and a column about 70 characters wide.

The palette derives from the Zapier DESIGN.md in VoltAgent/awesome-design-md; the dark values come from the sister site arc.fuet.ch.
keyCharacteristics: A 72 rem page for the masthead, lists and post header; a 40 rem reading column for text.
Warm cream and coffee neutrals; one orange accent.
Bricolage Grotesque for headings, the wordmark and year numerals; the system font for reading.
Light and dark themes with the same structure; Auto is the default.
Flat surfaces. Depth comes from tone, not shadows.

rules.name: The Large Orange Rule
rules.body: In the light theme, Electric Orange is for large text (the 2 rem year numerals), the wordmark dot and focus rings. Body-size links use Burnt Orange.

rules.name: The Paired Value Rule
rules.body: A new colour is added as one `light-dark()` pair on the root. No colour is set for one theme only.

rules.name: The Two Borders Rule
rules.body: Use `hairline` for decoration and `border` for anything a visitor must see to operate a control.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque speaks in headings, the wordmark, year numerals and neighbour links. Everything a visitor reads at length is in the system font. No Inter, no Degular, no third family.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are in sentence case at normal letter spacing. Nothing is set in uppercase with wide tracking.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a shadow, at rest or on hover. If something must stand apart, give it the Soft Cream ground or more space.

dos: Do keep running text in the 40 rem reading column with 18 px body text and a line height of 1.6.
Do use Bricolage Grotesque Variable for headings, the wordmark and year numerals, and the system font stack for everything else.
Do use Burnt Orange (#c2410c) for links in body text in the light theme, and Electric Orange (#ff4f00) for links in the dark theme.
Do define every colour as a `light-dark()` pair, and check both themes.
Do use 12 px corners for images and panels, and 6 px corners for controls, inline code and focus rings.
Do separate things with space first, then a Soft Cream panel, then a 1 px hairline.
Do show a 2 px Electric Orange focus ring, 3 px away from the element, on everything that takes focus.
Do set the `lang` of each post on its title and its text, so hyphenation is correct.
donts: Don't use Electric Orange for body-size text on the cream canvas; it reaches only 3.27:1.
Don't use Inter, Degular or any other web font. One font file is loaded and no more.
Don't use pill shapes, or any radius other than 6 px and 12 px.
Don't turn the post list into a card grid. Covers sit beside rows; they do not become tiles.
Don't use a hairline as the border of a control; use the Control Border.
Don't load anything from another server: no font services, no embeds, no analytics.
